cohort: The study included 44 women with Multiple Sclerosis, with a mean age of 46.3 years, all of whom experienced at least mild bladder dysfunction.
finding: The perceived severity of bladder dysfunction was not associated with balance or the prevalence of falling, but rather with an increased fear of falling in women with MS.
mod_finding: The study controlled for the number of vaginal deliveries when examining the relationships between bladder dysfunction and fall-related outcomes.
cross-section timing: Data was collected at a single point in time.
